Love this. And honestly… don’t downplay that background, that’s exactly what most med spas are missing.

A lot of owners don’t have an operations problem on the surface, they think it’s marketing or leads. But when you actually get inside the business, it’s usually things like:
- No clear patient journey from lead → consult → treatment → retention  
- Front desk not trained to convert or follow up properly  
- No-show rates killing the schedule  
- Zero automation or inconsistent systems  
- Underutilized providers and expensive equipment sitting idle  
- No real retention engine like memberships or packages  

So your skillset in ops, automation, AI, and systems is actually a massive advantage if applied the right way in this space.

The nuance you’ll want to learn is that med spas are equal parts:
1. Medical environment (compliance, scope, medical director, etc.)  
2. Luxury service business (experience matters a lot)  
3. Sales organization (without feeling “salesy”)  

The biggest pain point I see across the board is not getting people in the door… it’s what happens after they show interest. That’s where most revenue is lost.

If you can help a practice:
- Tighten systems  
- Improve consult conversions  
- Reduce no-shows  
- Increase lifetime value per patient  

You’ll be wildly valuable.

You’re in the right place. This industry needs more operators who actually understand how to build a real business behind the brand.
